body.title: Git porcelain parsers and assertSafeArg
body.summary: Add parsers.ts with deterministic parsers for status v2 -z (moved out of status.ts), for-each-ref with a fixed format, ls-tree -z, ls-files -z, rev-list, log with a fixed format and record separator, and show-ref. Every parser fails with a rejected failure carrying the raw text in original when the output does not parse or stdoutTruncated is true. Add assertSafeArg(value, position).
acceptanceChecks: Each parser returns the typed records for real git output and fails with original set for malformed output
A truncated stdout is never turned into a partial list
status.ts uses the moved parser with identical results
assertSafeArg rejects a dash-prefixed value in a ref or path position

tests.name: src/daemon/tools/builtins/git/__tests__/git-parsers.test.ts: each parser turns fixed sample output into the expected records and handles -z paths with spaces, unicode and newlines
src/daemon/tools/builtins/git/__tests__/git-parsers.test.ts: a parser refuses cut output and unknown records
src/daemon/tools/builtins/git/__tests__/git-parsers.test.ts: assertSafeArg rejects a value that starts with a dash or holds a NUL
